title: Synthetic Data Vault (SDV)
summary: This is the SDV library itself, an ecosystem for generating synthetic single-table, multi-table and timeseries data using copula- and deep-learning-based models with metadata schemas, constraints and conditional sampling. The repository is an in-tree copy of the SDV, CTGAN, RDT, SDMetrics and Copulas source code, with its own test suite exercising GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, HMA-style multi-table modeling and the evaluate() quality-scoring function.
evidence: sdv/tabular/ctgan.py:3 'import ctgan'; sdv/evaluation.py:4 'import sdmetrics'; directories sdv/, docs/developer_guides/sdv mirror SDV source
needs: This repository appears to be a verbatim mirror of the first-party sdv-dev/SDV project (README, setup.py author info, and full source tree all match SDV itself), scraped into a test-org account; treat as first-party SDV work rather than a third-party consumer.
